slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: Hook-timestamped block start and end events analyzed over an ABAB crossover of ten working days.
A bootstrap 95% interval on the ratio of median minutes-to-unblock, required to show at least a one-third reduction.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 7 of 9. Proof. How you know it worked. Hook-timestamped block start and end events analyzed over an ABAB crossover of ten working days. A bootstrap 95% interval on the ratio of median minutes-to-unblock, required to show at least a one-third reduction.

slides.heading: Blocks not detected: idle waits never emit a Notification
paras: agents found waiting with no hand raised.
add a no-event-for-N-minutes heuristic and log it as a distinct reason.
